title: Logitech diNovo Bluetooth Ultra-Flat Keyboard Y-RZ42 867610-0403 Untested
condition_description: Untested, sold as-is for parts or repair. Keyboard only - no Bluetooth receiver, MediaPad, mouse or power adapter. Scuffs and wear marks on the palm rest and underside; sticky residue around the battery compartment edges and light discoloration on the spring (pictured).
description:
Logitech diNovo Keyboard - Bluetooth ultra-flat keyboard, model Y-RZ42, P/N 867610-0403 (c)2005.

- Full-size low-profile layout with brushed silver aluminum-look trim
- Media wheel (play/pause, skip, stop) and MEDIA button
- Volume up / mute / down and quick-launch buttons (home, mail, messenger)
- F-Lock function row: New, Reply, Forward, Send, Undo, Redo, Print, Save, My Comp, My Doc, My Pic, My Music
- Runs on 4 AA batteries (not included)

Condition: untested - sold as-is, for parts or repair. Keyboard only: no Bluetooth receiver/hub, MediaPad, mouse or adapter. All keys present. Scuffs and wear marks on the palm rest and the underside; the battery compartment has sticky residue around the edges and light discoloration on the spring (see close-up). Battery cover included.

Please see all photos - they are part of the description.
